pos.intro: Settled orders are transmitted to the counter register over the local network, so the cashier never re-keys an order this system already holds. The register on the receiving end is simulated for this prototype.

priority.title: Do you qualify for priority service?
priority.prompt: Choose only what applies to you. Staff may ask to see your ID.
priority.discountNote: Senior citizens and persons with disability receive a 20% discount with VAT exemption.
priority.pregnantNote: Pregnant diners are served ahead of the queue. No discount applies.
priority.savedDiscount: Discount pending: show your ID at the cashier
priority.idVerificationReminder: Your 20% discount with VAT exemption is held until staff check your OSCA or PWD ID at the counter.
priority.privacyHeading: Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173)
priority.privacyBody1: This system uses no cameras, facial recognition or biometric tracking. Priority status is voluntary and self-declared.
priority.privacyBody2: When staff verify a Senior Citizen (RA 9994) or PWD (RA 10754) discount, the restaurant records your ID number, cardholder name and issuing LGU for BIR tax-audit compliance only.
priority.privacyBody3: ID numbers and names are masked on staff screens by default and kept only for the statutory audit period.
